extracted.intended_audience: patent examiners, patent attorneys/agents, and practitioners before the USPTO
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance on the optional inter partes reexamination procedure (MPEP chapter 2600), including procedural requirements, filing content, decision criteria, and conduct of proceedings. Note: the procedure was replaced by inter partes review for requests filed on/after Sept 16, 2012; this chapter records the former practice.

rubrics_metrics.name: Introduction
rubrics_metrics.description: Explains statutory origin and current status of optional inter partes reexamination (added by AIPA, later replaced by AIA).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: States that Office does not accept requests filed on/after Sept 16, 2012 (37 CFR 1.913(b)) and points to earlier MPEP revisions (e.g., revision 07.2022 of 9th Edition) for former practice guidance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Flowcharts
rubrics_metrics.description: Flowchart-level depiction of procedure steps for inter partes reexamination.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Flowcharts for the former practice are available in revision 07.2022 of the 9th Edition of the MPEP.

rubrics_metrics.name: Citation of Prior Art
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedures for submitting citations of prior art (patents/printed publications) to the Office in the context of reexamination or other proceedings.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Citations of prior art continue to be allowed under 37 CFR 1.501; handling described in MPEP §§ 2202–2206 and 2208. For inter partes reexamination requests filed prior to Sept 16, 2012, citations under 1.501 would be processed in accordance with 37 CFR 1.902. See 37 CFR 1.913(b).

rubrics_metrics.name: Inter Partes Reexamination
rubrics_metrics.description: Top-level topic heading for the optional inter partes reexamination procedure.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Office does not accept inter partes reexamination requests filed on/after Sept 16, 2012; see 37 CFR 1.913(b) and earlier MPEP revisions for former practice.

rubrics_metrics.name: Request for Inter Partes Reexamination
rubrics_metrics.description: Requirements and content/processing related to a third-party request to institute an inter partes reexamination.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Office does not accept requests filed on/after Sept 16, 2012. See prior MPEP revisions for former procedural and content requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Time for Requesting Inter Partes Reexamination
rubrics_metrics.description: Timing constraints and windows for filing a request for inter partes reexamination.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Office does not accept requests filed on/after Sept 16, 2012; consult earlier MPEP revisions for former timing rules.

rubrics_metrics.name: Persons Who May File a Request
rubrics_metrics.description: Who is eligible to file an inter partes reexamination request (e.g., third parties).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Procedure is obsolete for filings on/after Sept 16, 2012; see earlier MPEP material for specifics on eligibility and representative rules.

rubrics_metrics.name: Representative of Requester
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules about who may represent a requester in inter partes reexamination (e.g., practitioner requirements).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Office does not accept new inter partes reexamination requests after Sept 16, 2012; see earlier MPEP revision for former representative rules.

rubrics_metrics.name: Content of Request for Inter Partes Reexamination
rubrics_metrics.description: What the request must contain (e.g., identification of patent, statement of reasons, supporting copies of cited prior art).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Office does not accept requests filed on/after Sept 16, 2012; consult the cited earlier MPEP revision for the detailed former content requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Fee for Requesting Inter Partes Reexamination
rubrics_metrics.description: Fee requirements for filing a request to institute inter partes reexamination.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Office does not accept requests filed on/after Sept 16, 2012; fee information and handling for the former practice appear in prior MPEP revision.

rubrics_metrics.name: Substantial New Question of Patentability/Reasonable Likelihood That Requester Will Prevail
rubrics_metrics.description: Threshold standard the Office used to determine whether to order inter partes reexamination — existence of a substantial new question of patentability and reasonable likelihood of requester prevailing.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This was a key criterion for instituting inter partes reexamination under the former statutory framework; Office no longer accepts such requests as of Sept 16, 2012 (see 37 CFR 1.913(b)).

rubrics_metrics.name: Statement in the Request Applying Prior Art
rubrics_metrics.description: Requirement that the request include a statement applying the cited prior art to the patent claims (i.e., explanation of why cited art raises a substantial new question).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Office does not accept requests filed on/after Sept 16, 2012; see earlier MPEP revision for the former form and level of detail required in such statements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Copies of Prior Art (Patents and Printed Publications)

rubrics_metrics.guidance: Office does not accept requests filed on/after Sept 16, 2012; prior practice and copy requirements available in previous MPEP revision.

rubrics_metrics.name: Copy of Printed Patent

rubrics_metrics.guidance: Office does not accept requests filed on/after Sept 16, 2012; see prior MPEP guidance for former handling.

rubrics_metrics.name: Certificate of Service
